title: Master Abhyasa Gana Curriculum Database
description: Unified Master Curriculum v2 for Naadopaasana (72 Melakartas + 9 Janyas) harmonised with exact Medhaa web UI notation (dashes/holds), note counters, regional scripts (Devanagari, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada), and Śruti/Tāla trainer engines.
baseline_mela_note: Mela #15 (Māyāmāḷavagauḷa) is included for continuous 1-72 array indexing with is_baseline_reference: true, preserving seamless compatibility with pre-existing Naadopaasana modules.

schema_compatibility.dual_access_supported: Both mela.sarali_varisai and mela.exercises.sarali_varisai are supported.
schema_compatibility.alankara_alias_supported: Both mela.alankaras and mela.suladi_sapta_tala_alankaras are supported.
schema_compatibility.sthayi_alias_supported: Both ex.parts and ex.sections are supported in Mel Sthayi and Kil Sthayi.
